Alcohol makes you pee more because ` [Highlight start] it acts as a diuretic by blocking the release of antidiuretic hormone (ADH), also called vasopressin [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF18y9PXXQKe-7fz1aJpsh_XmXOety5BnpiBtmYab8cz4IZ-15ZfArDEGcOlTOV6nRtE966falVm8nZ2lx-FA5PMoZIzxvXjCO5dK6dSIHl3MYQS8um6ZfFH3jlemOmUgwpSM6WOdoDYGaohAmBZM0Xu-iyLTK2kgyT9o02pKRvo0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXnLImu3jQ-FnhWAAysJXrQsrNK27H1-z6aZGkC-K1nMRx76YeIAG1Ds6gEepOa2gGj3nibG5JDf-PNaJbQ3HkxJ9p-X-O0EMa922BlMSFVhIPF9gSjVsFwWBJ-O7c5tT3vCg9xbAfswzMMwTmeEI5aEHzOk9l)

Normally, ADH signals your kidneys to hold onto water. When alcohol suppresses this hormone, your kidneys send more fluid straight to your bladder instead of reabsorbing it.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXnLImu3jQ-FnhWAAysJXrQsrNK27H1-z6aZGkC-K1nMRx76YeIAG1Ds6gEepOa2gGj3nibG5JDf-PNaJbQ3HkxJ9p-X-O0EMa922BlMSFVhIPF9gSjVsFwWBJ-O7c5tT3vCg9xbAfswzMMwTmeEI5aEHzOk9l)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF18y9PXXQKe-7fz1aJpsh_XmXOety5BnpiBtmYab8cz4IZ-15ZfArDEGcOlTOV6nRtE966falVm8nZ2lx-FA5PMoZIzxvXjCO5dK6dSIHl3MYQS8um6ZfFH3jlemOmUgwpSM6WOdoDYGaohAmBZM0Xu-iyLTK2kgyT9o02pKRvo0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF107D4i2BRmU6yQ_QNwCs8TQkvABIXHvR1dLF_mG3yLrizj3K5pEr0ykp3edeJo_hOTmLq7fNtyoKO1hDofmdM9hCu-qdhJnuBfLqqijjzF8w0db42KXOKzQBtXAO7nn1b9dqVjx3jpIKKRpsxWnRiv5aCtaytBQ2pqH4JSQu3H9UXYvUhoEb-r2_ccPNFnWfnQ)

Other factors that add to the urge include:

- **Liquid volume:** Drinking pints of beer or mixed drinks simply puts more fluid into your body.
- **Bladder irritation:** Alcohol, carbonation, and caffeinated or acidic mixers can irritate the bladder lining and increase urgency.
- **Drink strength:** Beverages with higher alcohol content have a stronger diuretic effect.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXiYI-vY8xr28ca7pyn3MBUUjQ--bciNeWVCWvi9QH_3hY2k11VQKzkiA4AokwOzpcke84SkxEryX8qxpyYu_K740ZhzzMOu3VfN5ArFWDcmC31FdTkkgKSQeQ-p_SUGSRmb-gT_mW3ZOJZhbL-uXvCt5TvweXDYjQMQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF107D4i2BRmU6yQ_QNwCs8TQkvABIXHvR1dLF_mG3yLrizj3K5pEr0ykp3edeJo_hOTmLq7fNtyoKO1hDofmdM9hCu-qdhJnuBfLqqijjzF8w0db42KXOKzQBtXAO7nn1b9dqVjx3jpIKKRpsxWnRiv5aCtaytBQ2pqH4JSQu3H9UXYvUhoEb-r2_ccPNFnWfnQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF18y9PXXQKe-7fz1aJpsh_XmXOety5BnpiBtmYab8cz4IZ-15ZfArDEGcOlTOV6nRtE966falVm8nZ2lx-FA5PMoZIzxvXjCO5dK6dSIHl3MYQS8um6ZfFH3jlemOmUgwpSM6WOdoDYGaohAmBZM0Xu-iyLTK2kgyT9o02pKRvo0)

Because you lose fluids faster than you replace them, frequent urination from alcohol can lead to dehydration and worsen hangover symptoms. You can explore more details on how alcohol affects water retention on [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXnLImu3jQ-FnhWAAysJXrQsrNK27H1-z6aZGkC-K1nMRx76YeIAG1Ds6gEepOa2gGj3nibG5JDf-PNaJbQ3HkxJ9p-X-O0EMa922BlMSFVhIPF9gSjVsFwWBJ-O7c5tT3vCg9xbAfswzMMwTmeEI5aEHzOk9l) , or read about the specific effects of beer in this [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXhVGT4bQNjT6Gwu6Mt0MMYexlJLs1OwFf8U1zTKx4dylnJOQb9pfMHbbj2Yy5841efWgg_t6mW8dU-ji_0JHe0KrSMUPLuW-k5pCGkL6CS2GJN7B3h9NBaPgMdEm4a_Odzzjol_4aeCs) article.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESogEBxCJF1xGzkedWaBJufZbU0-TTrIsRPKXg_75LG83oLHW2B98T5CHxUT2hhDRyA9Ih6sNMn0QHksnO6bpvjZ-21E0_FQytUwG5dvzK1lK81HKddXtAJ0Rynjy2bj_7dsqDUxgxT9mcQ4rZIOBfUEWJ3tgIoEq2svL8d-VKxCy4pzBfhl-f9yYXC4OLPkIBePNUHz4b8DkRsR7oBjwUoY4fb38)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShAEBxCJF18y9PXXQKe-7fz1aJpsh_XmXOety5BnpiBtmYab8cz4IZ-15ZfArDEGcOlTOV6nRtE966falVm8nZ2lx-FA5PMoZIzxvXjCO5dK6dSIHl3MYQS8um6ZfFH3jlemOmUgwpSM6WOdoDYGaohAmBZM0Xu-iyLTK2kgyT9o02pKRvo0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXnLImu3jQ-FnhWAAysJXrQsrNK27H1-z6aZGkC-K1nMRx76YeIAG1Ds6gEepOa2gGj3nibG5JDf-PNaJbQ3HkxJ9p-X-O0EMa922BlMSFVhIPF9gSjVsFwWBJ-O7c5tT3vCg9xbAfswzMMwTmeEI5aEHzOk9l)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXhVGT4bQNjT6Gwu6Mt0MMYexlJLs1OwFf8U1zTKx4dylnJOQb9pfMHbbj2Yy5841efWgg_t6mW8dU-ji_0JHe0KrSMUPLuW-k5pCGkL6CS2GJN7B3h9NBaPgMdEm4a_Odzzjol_4aeCs)Are you looking into this because of **frequent urination** after drinking, **dehydration and hangovers** , or **bladder symptoms** like urgency or discomfort?
